anomalies.Detailed Analysis: The item is labeled 'Veg Sandwich' immediately following the legitimate Veg Sandwich ('Fresh Veg Mix, Eggless Mayo, White Bread', Rs.280). However, the ingredients listed are explicitly 'Noodles, Veggie, Soup', which corresponds directly to Veg Thukpa (compare with Page 4 Chicken/Buff Thukpa: 'Buff/Chicken Meat, Noodles, Veggies, Soup'). The name 'Veg Sandwich' was mistakenly duplicated by the menu graphic designer.
anomalies.Recommended Action for Review: Confirm with kitchen/management whether this item should be updated to 'Veg Thukpa' at Rs.280, or if a different sandwich formulation was intended.

anomalies.Detailed Analysis: Milk Tea is priced at Rs.70 (Rs.20 higher than Black Tea at Rs.50), but its printed description is identical to Black Tea ('Nepali style Black Tea'). The description omits milk/dairy ingredients and house spice details.
anomalies.Recommended Action for Review: Update description to accurately state milk and tea brew ingredients (e.g. 'Nepali style Brewed Black Tea with Milk and Spices').

anomalies.Detailed Analysis: Milk Coffee (Rs.140) literally has 'Nepali style Black Tea' printed beneath its name. This is an indisputable copy-paste error from the tea section above it.
anomalies.Recommended Action for Review: Correct printed description to 'Instant Coffee with Steamed Fresh Milk'.

anomalies.Printed Description: Choice of meats, Seasonal Veggies, Sausage, Salami, Ham, House Dips and Sauces
anomalies.Detailed Analysis: Printed as 'Do It Yourself Patter' without the letter 'l' in both the section header and item name. Context clearly indicates a 'Do It Yourself Platter'.
anomalies.Recommended Action for Review: Correct spelling to 'Do It Yourself Platter' on digital menus and POS.

anomalies.Printed Description: Crispy Fried Chicken, Korean Pasta, Sesame Seeds
anomalies.Detailed Analysis: Description states 'Korean Pasta'. In authentic Korean Fried Chicken dishes, this typically refers to 'Korean Paste' (Gochujang chili paste) rather than pasta noodles.
anomalies.Recommended Action for Review: Verify whether this is indeed Korean chili paste (Gochujang) or an actual pasta accompaniment.

anomalies.Detailed Analysis: Priced as 'Rs1900' whereas every other item uses 'Rs.' with period/space notation (e.g. 'Rs.1050', 'Rs.3500').
Priced at Rs.50, but neither the bottle volume (e.g. 500ml vs 1L) nor brand (Kinley, Aqua, Bailey) is stated.
anomalies.Recommended Action for Review: Specify bottle size (e.g. '1 Litre Sealed Bottle') on customer menus.

anomalies.Detailed Analysis: Prices are Rs.550 for Gorkha Strong and Rs.590 for Barashinghe and Tuborg. Bottle size (650ml standard bottle vs 500ml can) is unstated.
